description: This file contains a Go implementation of a master count-based endpoint reconciler for Kubernetes, managing endpoint objects to ensure the correct number of master nodes are represented.

classes.name: masterCountEndpointReconciler
classes.description: A struct that manages endpoint reconciliation based on a specified master count, ensuring endpoints reflect the desired number of master nodes.

methods.name: ReconcileEndpoints
methods.description: Sets or updates the endpoints for a given service to match the expected master count, adding or removing IP addresses as needed.

methods.name: RemoveEndpoints
methods.description: Removes a specific IP address from the endpoints of a service.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup, currently does nothing.
